highlights_headline: SkiaSharp restores Linux NoDependencies font discovery and raises Tizen native assets to the Tizen 10 platform floor.
highlights_body: The bundled m155 fork also receives upstream-alignment cleanup while native Windows build provenance is tightened.

breaking.title: Tizen 8 and 9 native assets are no longer supported
breaking.body: The Tizen native packages now target Tizen 10. Update Tizen applications and build environments to Tizen 10 or later before taking this release.

bullets.detail: Linux applications using the NoDependencies package can again find installed system fonts through the default font manager.

contributor_summaries.ramezgerges: Restored system-font discovery for Linux NoDependencies deployments
